GM East Africa (GM) markets and sells Chevrolet, Opel and
Isuzu vehicles and parts. It locally assembles the Isuzu and
Chevrolet vehicles. Majority of GM’s sales are domestic.
GM also exports to neighboring countries in the COMESA
region: Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Zambia,
Zimbabwe, Mozambique and Ethiopia.GM East Africa has

over 30 years experience in local assembly and service.
